title: F0003 Runtime Metric Snapshot
description: Derived run-health view (F0003-S0006). Never authoritative: every metric must be recomputable from runtime state and the artifact index, and `derived_from` pins the inputs it was computed against so a reader can verify that.

derived_from.description: Inputs this snapshot was computed from. Recomputing against the same revisions must reproduce the same values; differing revisions mean the snapshot is superseded, not wrong.

metric_name.description: Closed set. A new metric is a schema change, so consumers never meet an unknown key.

metric_value.description: Numeric for counts and durations; categorical for transcript_health and evidence_freshness; the validator name for latest_failing_validator. Null when not applicable to this run — e.g. blocked_launch_count on a run that never attempted a guarded launch.

metric_kind.description: Lets a consumer format the value without special-casing each metric_name.

applicable.description: False when the metric does not apply to this run. Distinguishes 'not applicable' from a genuine zero.
